items.stem: An architect designs a detection-and-response capability that unifies endpoint, identity, email and cloud-app signals with a SIEM for long-term correlation. Which combination best fits?

options.text: Microsoft Defender XDR with Microsoft Sentinel
options.rationale: Correct: Defender XDR unifies endpoint, identity, email and cloud-app signals, and Sentinel adds cloud-native SIEM correlation and SOAR.
Defender for Endpoint covers endpoints alone and is not a full XDR-plus-SIEM solution.
These are governance controls, not a detection-and-response capability.

options.text: Microsoft Entra ID P1 licensing alone
options.rationale: Licensing enables identity features but is not a detection-and-response design.

items.stem: To translate regulatory requirements into enforced controls and demonstrate compliance, which Microsoft solution should the design centre on?

options.text: Microsoft Purview with Azure Policy and Defender for Cloud regulatory compliance
options.rationale: Correct: Purview, Azure Policy and Defender for Cloud together translate, enforce and evidence regulatory controls.
Entra Internet Access is a secure web gateway, not a compliance-control framework.
A load balancer distributes traffic and has no compliance role.
LAPS manages local administrator passwords; it does not translate regulatory requirements into controls.
